name: flatoutnz
description: flatoutnz.co.nz. The website itself is plain HTML and CSS with no build step; this file exists only so Netlify installs the one package the employees panel's storage function needs. Pinned to 10.x on purpose: 11.x requires Node 22, which would mean also setting NODE_VERSION in Netlify. 10.x runs on Node 16 and up.
